$comment: Coverage ratchet cut point — spec versioning-test-coverage (design ADR 7.8, Q5/Q6). Code introduced by the two active branches (their diffs vs these merge-bases) is the 'new code' that must validate the test bar; everything before is grandfathered (non-regression only). Sonar 'New Code' period must be anchored on these SHAs (project settings → New Code → Reference branch/Specific analysis). Target: 90% new-code coverage.
grandfathered: everything reachable from the merge-bases above
hardBarScope: feat/versioning diff (this spec); feat/real-time-events via its own future spec — until then, non-regression only
